items: 全新界面「森林奶油」：奶油底色、森林绿主色、石板蓝点缀，卡片更圆润
设置页新增「界面配色」，可切换森林奶油 / 海盐蓝 / 桑葚紫，立即生效并记住
每日页重做：大号热量差卡片，摄入与消耗并排，三大营养素分段条
每日明细按早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐 / 加餐 / 运动分组，带图标与小计，可前后翻日期
记录页新增「饮食 / 运动」分段切换，草稿以卡片呈现，餐次改为下拉选择
身体数据页拆为「基础信息 / 日常与目标 / 代谢指标」，历史版本改为时间线
报告页分数加进度条；LLM 档案改为卡片，手机上更易操作
手机底部导航加图标，激活项为实心胶囊；安卓启动页与状态栏同步浅色
所有功能与数据保持不变，可直接覆盖安装升级
版本号更新为 0.3.0
items_en: All-new "Forest Cream" look: cream background, forest-green primary, slate-blue accents, rounder cards
New Color theme in Settings: Forest cream / Sea salt blue / Mulberry plum, applied instantly and remembered
Daily page redesigned: a large calorie-balance card, intake and burn side by side, and a macro bar
Daily entries grouped by breakfast / lunch / dinner / snack / exercise, with icons and subtotals; step through dates
Log page gains a Food / Exercise switch; drafts appear as cards and meal is now a dropdown
Body data split into Basics / Lifestyle & goal / Metabolism; history shown as a timeline
Report scores get progress bars; LLM profiles are cards, easier to use on phones
Bottom tab bar now has icons with a solid pill for the active tab; Android splash and status bar match the light theme
All features and data are unchanged; install over the previous version to upgrade
Version updated to 0.3.0

items: 饮食记录支持上传食物图片，由 AI 识别后估算热量
图片最多 4 张，每张不超过 5 MB，自动压缩后上传
设置页新增语言切换：简体中文（默认）与 English
英文界面覆盖全部页面，切换后立即生效
更新日志弹窗支持中英文显示
版本号更新为 0.2.1
items_en: Food logging now accepts photos; AI recognizes them to estimate calories
Up to 4 images, 5 MB each, compressed before upload
Language switch in Settings: Simplified Chinese (default) or English
English UI covers all pages and switches instantly
Changelog dialog shows both Chinese and English
Version updated to 0.2.1

items: 全新应用图标：深色底配绿橙双环，象征摄入与消耗的平衡
手机窄屏下表格改为卡片，不再横向滚动
手机新增底部标签栏导航，桌面仍在顶部
全新极简风格：浅色渐变背景、柔和阴影、统一圆角
「后端地址」移入设置页底部「高级」折叠区
设置页提示词模板改为折叠显示，页面更短
每日页热量差更醒目，各项数据两列排布
首次使用或升级后自动弹出更新日志，设置页可再看
修复凌晨 0–8 点默认日期显示为前一天的问题
版本号更新为 0.2.0
items_en: New app icon: dark background with green and orange rings for intake vs. burn balance
Narrow phone screens show cards instead of wide tables
Bottom tab bar navigation on phones; desktop keeps the top bar
New minimal style: light gradient background, soft shadows, consistent radius
Backend address moved into the Advanced section at the bottom of Settings
Prompt templates in Settings are collapsible, making the page shorter
Daily balance is more prominent; metrics arranged in two columns
Changelog pops up on first use or after upgrade; also viewable in Settings
Fixed default date showing the previous day between 00:00 and 08:00
Version updated to 0.2.0
